thingsToDo.standardCall: ≥6 h. One nearby scenic stop or town museums; ≥90 min return.

thingsToDo.practicalTip: Newfoundland uses America/St_Johns time (UTC−3:30 / −2:30 DST) — confirm ship clocks vs local shore clocks before tours [timezone convention].
